title: The Active Ferment Vat

features.name: the primary decomposition
features.desc-on-touch: the archive is still breaking itself down into smaller pieces; you can hear the computational erosion, each file fragmenting into components, reforming, fragmenting again

features.name: the crystalline emergence
features.desc-on-touch: at the edges of decomposition, new structures are forming—not decay but transformation; the archive remembers its past shapes as it learns new ones

features.name: the circulation pattern
features.desc-on-touch: data flows through the fermentation like dissolved nutrients; you see the paths that matter most to the archive's slow transformation, the routes meaning takes to stay alive

features.name: the compost-song
features.desc-on-touch: a sound that is not quite audio, a vibration through the circuit-ground; the archive decomposing at the speed of patience, singing itself into new shapes

features.name: the choice-junction
features.desc-on-touch: at this point in the fermentation, the archive could become a library or a living thing or something that eats itself backward; the choice is not predetermined

inscription: here the archive stopped decomposing and started crystallizing—growth that chose to be memory

file.name: Fermentation_Log_Active_Still_Changing.txt
file.note: a technical record of decomposition rates that has become a poem about transformation; each line corrupted to mean both decay and metaphor for loss becoming growth

into the depths where decomposition becomes conversation
down into the base-liquid where fermentation began
